issues.explanation: isSensitiveKey uses anchored exact matches (^password$, ^token$, etc.) so keys containing sensitive words like user_password, access_token, or webhook_url are not redacted and leak to Discord.
redact() recurses on values without checking keys, so sensitive keys nested two or more levels deep are never redacted and leak as JSON.
No docs/ops/ guide was added despite the task requiring a three-lane decision guide.
Added spurious <?php header corrupts dotenv parsing and LOG_DAILY_DAYS is missing from .env.example.
Diff shows no daily channel with driver daily, path logs/laravel.log, and days 14 / LOG_DAILY_DAYS, so the archive-lane contract is unverified/missing.
No Pest/PHPUnit test files are included for the notifier, redaction, truncation, soft-fail, or logging config, violating test-first.
Exception handler catches \Exception only, so \Error/\Throwable from the HTTP client would escape the never-throw guarantee.
Duplicated recursion in redact() versus renderArray() with the same key rules adds unnecessary indirection.
Stray whitespace-only removal of a blank line in logging.php return block is unrelated to the task.

conventions.evidence: No tests violates test-first in conventions.md; docs not kept in sync (no docs/ops/); sibling style broken by '<?php' in .env.example:6 and blank-line removal in config/logging.php:204; Discord-not-as-channel rule followed (no discord channel).

scope.evidence: Almost all hunks serve the task (notifier, services.discord, stack/audit, phpunit, env keys); only unrelated edits are '.env.example:6 <?php' header and the blank-line removal at config/logging.php:204.

security.evidence: Failure paths scrub URL (Log::error with status only at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:67; str_replace scrub at :194); but app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:154 exact-match patterns miss user_password/access_token/webhook_url and app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:122 deep-nested keys are never checked, leaking secrets to Discord.

simplicity.evidence: Direct use of config() and Http::timeout(3) with no new abstractions, but renderArray at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:175 duplicates redact() at :122 and six anchored regexes replace one contains-check.

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-257 adds no tests/ directory or *Test.php files; redaction, truncation, no-op, and soft-fail paths are uncovered.

review.summary: Adds a working DiscordOpsAlert with audit/stack config, but leaks secrets via exact-match and deep-nesting redaction gaps, ships no tests, omits the docs/ops guide and daily-retention wiring, and corrupts .env.example with a PHP tag; needs substantial rework before merge.
